candidates.hypothesis: Entry net edge filter reduces trading losses after realistic fees
candidates.risk: Missed trends, erroneous forecasts and optimistic maker fills

candidates.name: Candle finality and timing replay
candidates.origin: Continued candidate; all earlier outcomes retained in dated archives
candidates.hypothesis: Final candles and explicit timing reduce leakage and replay mismatch
candidates.risk: Latency, historical arrival assumptions, data gaps
candidates.passCriteria: 100% decisions use already-final and received candles; fill after decision; no duplicate timestamps, lookahead or synthetic bars; evidence-labeled gaps; last30days untouched holdout; cost model from candidate01; report netPnL/DD/exposure/opportunity cost

candidates.additionalRisk: Local wall clock close-time filter alone does not prove Kraken last-row finality when a response straddles the hour boundary.

candidates.name: Explicit position and timeframe evidence for AI reviews
candidates.hypothesis: Providing a dated virtual position, cash, cost and timeframe may reduce unsupported EXIT explanations while retaining the deterministic execution envelope. This is not a claim of more trades or higher profit.
candidates.performed: Audited review call site at recorded main commit and compared latest copied review with paper ledger.
candidates.benefit: Ground commentary in actual inventory and distinguish no-op EXIT from selling an open position.
candidates.risk: More tokens, stale position snapshot, prompt drift, and unsupported confidence; context alone cannot create baseline entries.
candidates.passCriteria: Isolated candidate only. Freeze context contract and fixtures before test; require accurate inventory/timeframe on all held-out review cases, zero fabricated facts, and unchanged action/risk constraints. Chronological train90/test30 >=3 folds on verified >=180-day data; only already-received data; fills after decision; cost stress as candidate01; at least30 closed OOS trades for profit judgment, positive median incremental netPnL and no DD>8% or exposure>15%. Retain all failed cases. No promotion to primary.
missing: Candidate context implementation in an isolated branch/module
